question: What is the in-coverage network coverage scenario in NR-V2X?
options: When the communicating UEs are all out of the coverage of any gNB
When at least one of the communicating UEs is in-coverage and have a connection to a gNB
When the communicating UEs on SL are located within the coverage of a gNB
When all UEs are partially covered by a gNB
None of the above
correct_answer: When the communicating UEs on SL are located within the coverage of a gNB

question: What are the different types of requirements for different 5G usages? [3GPP Release 18]
options: Enhanced Mobile Broadband (eMBB), Critical Communications (CC) and Ultra Reliable and Low Latency Communications (URLLC), Flexible network operations
Massive Internet of Things (mIoT), Smart cities, Media and entertainment
Transport, logistics, IoT, Discrete automation, Smart cities
Public Safety, Health and wellness, Electriciy distribution
Transport, logistics, IoT, Media and entertainment
correct_answer: Enhanced Mobile Broadband (eMBB), Critical Communications (CC) and Ultra Reliable and Low Latency Communications (URLLC), Flexible network operations

question: What is the maximum relative velocity at which messages can be transferred between UEs supporting V2V applications? [3GPP Release 17]
options: 300 km/h
400 km/h
500 km/h
600 km/h

question: What does the Ndccf_DataManagement_Notify service operation do? [3GPP Release 18]
options: Subscribes to receive data or analytics via the DCCF
Unsubscribes from receiving data or analytics via the DCCF
Notifies the consumer instance of the requested data or analytics
Fetches data or analytics from the DCCF
correct_answer: Notifies the consumer instance of the requested data or analytics

question: What is the process of verifying if a Service User is authorized for MPS called? [3GPP Release 18]
options: End-to-End Priority Treatment
Service Invocation
Network Interconnection
Authorization
correct_answer: Authorization

question: Which of the following is a requirement for ensuring security in ranging services? [3GPP Release 17]
options: Ensuring the use of Ranging is only permitted in network coverage under the full control of the operator.
Ensuring that user privacy is not violated during ranging.
Supporting mechanisms for a UE to discover other UEs supporting ranging.
Supporting mechanisms for a UE to assist another UE in performing ranging.
correct_answer: Ensuring that user privacy is not violated during ranging.

question: What is the out-of-coverage network coverage scenario in NR-V2X?
options: When the communicating UEs are all out of the coverage of any gNB
When at least one of the communicating UEs is in-coverage and have a connection to a gNB
When the communicating UEs on SL are located within the coverage of a gNB

question: What is a Feature Set combination? [3GPP Release 18]

A set of contiguous serving cells
A two-dimensional matrix of feature sets per band
A set of alternative features
A set of aggregated carriers
correct_answer: A two-dimensional matrix of feature sets per band

question: What is periodic location reporting? [3GPP Release 17]
options: The act of the network operator monitoring the location and status of an asset
The act of the LCS Server initiating multiple position locations spread over a period of time
The act of the target UE querying the LCS server about any valid requests
The act of the PLMN supporting periodic location reporting for Emergency Services
The act of the LCS client activating requests for the target UE
correct_answer: The act of the LCS Server initiating multiple position locations spread over a period of time

question: What is the benefit of virtualization in the Frugal 5G network architecture?

It enables regional services
It allows for easier upgrades
It facilitates local content generation and consumption
It brings intelligence to the edge
correct_answer: It allows for easier upgrades

question: What was the main intention in LTE-V2X?

Support advanced use cases like platooning
Enhance reliability, latency, capacity, and flexibility
All of the above

question: What happens when the DNAI mapping information is changed in the UDR? [3GPP Release 18]

To establish connections with the gNB-CU-CP through the F1-C interface
To control the F1-U tunnels associated with an MBS Session
To uniquely identify the gNB-DU within a gNB-CU

To retrieve data or analytics from the DCCF

Set of Fetch Correlation ID(s)
